reasoning: Minnesota is structurally Democratic at the statewide level, with a Cook PVI of D+6. In the last 45 days, the only genuinely race-specific public signal I found was the August 2026 U.S. Senate primary: Peggy Flanagan won the DFL nomination and Michele Tafoya won the GOP nomination, but the available results and live-result pages are procedural rather than a current general-election margin; the most informative pre-primary polling cited a generic Democrat leading a generic Republican by 8 points and named-candidate polls showing Craig or Flanagan ahead Tafoya by about 7 points.
